title: What Does Your Cluttered Room Say About Your Mind?
description: Physical clutter reflects mental states. Let's see what your mess reveals about your psychology.

questions.text: What is the most common item on your floor?

choices.label: Art supplies and tangled cords
Old letters and random gifts
A mountain of unwashed clothes
Nothing (it's all shoved in the closet)

questions.text: How do you usually find your things?

choices.label: I just know the exact coordinates
I dig through my memory boxes
I don't, I just buy a new one
It's in the designated junk drawer

questions.text: Why haven't you cleaned up yet?

choices.label: I'm in the middle of a project!
What if I need this 5 years from now?
Too exhausted to even stand up
My room IS clean (don't open the wardrobe)
5 half-finished hobbies colliding
Covered in photos and souvenirs
Dirty mugs and snack wrappers
Perfectly clear, but chaotic drawers

questions.text: What happens when guests come over?

choices.label: I welcome them into the chaos
I show them my cool collections
I cancel the plan entirely
Aggressively sweep it all under the bed
